name: Universal Test Framework (UTF)
description: Polyglot test generation framework enforcing the 8-section test contract. Generates unit, integration, API, E2E, security, performance, and contract tests across Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, and C++. Works with zero local clone via uvx.

server.description: UTF MCP server — polyglot test generation with 8-section contract enforcement

tools.name: generate_tests
tools.description: Generate a complete test suite satisfying the 8-section test contract

tools.name: validate_test_contract
tools.description: Validate any test against the 8-section contract (score 0–1)

tools.name: suggest_test_types
tools.description: Analyze code and recommend test types with rationale

tools.name: analyze_coverage
tools.description: Identify coverage gaps in an existing test suite

tools.name: build_traceability_matrix
tools.description: Build a requirements → tests traceability matrix

tools.name: detect_language_framework
tools.description: Auto-detect programming language and test framework

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Execute test files and return structured CI results

tools.name: run_mutation_tests
tools.description: Run mutation testing and return mutation score

tools.name: query_registry
tools.description: Query the persistent test registry for existing tests

tools.name: import_test_results
tools.description: Import JUnit XML execution results into the UTF registry

tools.name: register_contracts
tools.description: Parse test file, extract per-method 8-section blocks, register as generated contracts

tools.name: feedback_status
tools.description: Get gap analysis, coverage health, and trend report

utf.description: Universal Test Framework — polyglot test generation with 8-section contract

quickstart.note: Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv). Paste the above entry into your VS Code mcp.json servers block.
